tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Search dinogame.gg's catalogue of free, no-install browser games (Tetris, 2048, Snake, chess, solitaire, Wordle-likes and dozens more). Returns each game's title, a short description, its controls, category, and a dinogame.gg URL to play it. Use when a user wants a game to play, a recommendation, or

tools.name: list_game_categories
tools.description: List the game categories on dinogame.gg with how many games each has and a browse URL. Use to discover what kinds of games are available before searching or browsing.

tools.name: browse_games_by_category
tools.description: Browse dinogame.gg games within a specific category (e.g. "puzzle", "arcade", "multiplayer"). Returns games with play links. Use category slugs from list_game_categories.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search dinogame.gg's blog — 1000+ guides and round-ups about the Chrome Dino game, browser games, and how to play them. Returns title, excerpt, category and a dinogame.gg URL to cite. Use for questions about the Chrome Dino game's history/secrets/records, or "best games for X" style recommendations.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch the full text of one dinogame.gg blog article by its slug (the last path segment of a /blog/<slug>/ URL, also returned by search_articles). Returns the article body so you can summarise or quote it, plus its canonical URL to cite.

tools.name: play_dino
tools.description: Get the link to play the classic Chrome Dino (T-Rex Runner) game free in the browser on dinogame.gg. Use when a user wants to play the dinosaur game or take a quick break. The game runs on the website — share the link so they can play.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_articles" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Search dinogame.gg's blog — 1000+ guides and round-ups about the Chrome Dino game, browser games, and how to play them. Returns title, excerpt, category and a d…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_games, list_game_categories, search_articles, get_article · Private data: search_articles · Public sink: play_dino.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_games, list_game_categories, search_articles, get_article · Private data: search_articles · Public sink: play_dino

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
